query: how to scan a document to a searchable pdf on iphone offline
lead: Turning paper into a PDF is easy; turning it into a searchable PDF that never leaves your phone is the hard part. Most scanner apps only do the text recognition (OCR) in the cloud or lock it behind a subscription.
detail: A searchable PDF needs OCR — the app has to actually read the text in your scan so you can find it later. Many popular scanners send your document to a server to do that, which is a privacy problem for contracts, IDs and receipts, and others put OCR and export behind a monthly fee. That means sensitive paperwork is captured and made searchable without ever being uploaded.
